findings.title: A VPN-scoped import deletes every virtual hostname on the target, silently
Seven kubernetes.* values reach the broker CR unquoted with no load-time grammar (YAML/--- injection)
kubernetes.storage.class reaches kubectl argv as a bare positional, so config text can inject kubectl flags
WATCH_NAMESPACE read back from a running Deployment is rendered raw into the operator bundle an admin applies
Docker broker remove empties the data dir under a broker compose down did not find
Namespace emptiness gate misses RBAC, NetworkPolicy, Ingress and CR objects; --no-prompt then deletes the namespace
Primary-active switch gate is inverted when the local site is addressed through its backup node
PrimaryActive reads Enabled-Released (or an unreadable report) as standalone and passes the gate
An operator found in another namespace drives deploy and remove, which then write and delete in the resolved namespace
Create Usernames chunk cannot replay onto a target that already has a non-admin CLI user
InjectShutdown warnings are produced only after the teardown has run, not in the plan
operator remove --delete-crd is silently not honoured (exit 0) whenever the operator is kept
container.dataDir has no floor: '/' or '~' is accepted, chowned unprompted and emptied by --delete-data
Podman redeploy forgets a written-but-unapplied change and later reports 'unchanged, left running'
convert silently empties ${VAR} references to unassigned variables and copies $(...)/backtick/${VAR:-x} literally
A switch that fails mid-plan returns a bare error: VPNs left standby at both sites are not named
15 real-capture tests skip in every gate because their fixtures are gitignored and absent
platformOps is the single source of truth only for dispatchLeaf; 12 commands build it in RunE
A removed dry-run mode survives as 34 production branches keyed on the test-only Echo runner
kubernetes.ports accepts lowercase /tcp but renders it raw, and the CRD protocol enum is case-sensitive
replication via.kubernetes.namespace/name only checked non-empty, though they reach the mate's kubectl argv
Standalone routername filled from os.Hostname after Validate, bypassing validIdent before quadlet HostName=
bannerType scans the whole capture, so configuration text can decide the target's broker type
promoteConfirmed reads once for the whole phase and promotes anything not reading active
configure dr gate never mentions that unlisted replicating VPNs are shut down when the mate already matches
The kube context the prompt names is not pinned, so the deletes run against whatever context is current when each kubectl call starts
The CRD cascade gate reads an empty answer as "no brokers" and deletes the CRDs
`status broker --all` shows [ OK ] ready when ServiceReady or HAReady is unreported or Unknown
runUser uid 0 is accepted on docker and rootful podman, running the broker as host root
dataDir reaches the quadlet Volume= line unescaped: '%' is a systemd specifier, ':' splits the mount
broker deploy mutates the host before the redeploy question; 'a no leaves the host exactly as it was' does not hold
Bare `auto-complete` is a command-line error that exits 1, not 2
convert prints every secret to stdout, breaking the one-place secret-display invariant
Half of image.user/image.pass is silently discarded on Kubernetes and only refused at deploy on containers
v0.2.x schema keys (redundancy scalar, nodes, nodes.*.ip, storage.msgNode/monNode) were dropped, not refused by name
convert's validateOutput skips Load's '~' expansion and wrongly warns that '~/...' paths will not load
DecodeStrict reads only the first YAML document; anything after a second '---' is silently ignored
Interrupting an import leaves the credential-bearing driver on the broker and the apply running unobserved
Driver ignores failed chunk/wrapper writes and an empty transcript, so it can report OK for what never ran
No deadline on any mate call: a stalled SEMP peer or kubectl exec hangs the switch
PVC and CR deletes during `broker remove` have no timeout and run under context.Background
Podman server-certificate secret (private key) is orphaned in the store once tls.* is dropped
--watch turns a bad --pod into an endless retry loop that exits 0
vulnjudge passes an empty or message-boundary-truncated govulncheck stream as clean
Dead code with no production caller is kept covered by its own tests
set/MISSING and orNone rendering is duplicated per package and has already drifted
Error-path tests assert only err != nil and cannot tell which step failed or whether later writes ran
Secret-leak tests scan only stdout; stderr narration and returned errors are never checked
tag.yml has drifted from the init-devops template: any v* tag publishes a release that GitHub marks Latest
The Windows CI leg runs dev.ps1 under pwsh 7, so the PowerShell 5.1 compatibility it claims is never tested
Local gates build the shared module from ../go-deploy-utility through an untracked go.work, while CI and releases build v0.1.2, and nothing reports it
The vet task omits the gofmt -l check the dev-script contract requires, so no gate checks formatting
Nothing checks that the -X version stamp lands, so a rename would ship binaries that report 'dev'
dev.sh test aborts on bash older than 4.4 when SOLACE_RACE=0 (empty array under set -u)
broker stop and perform redundancy-test run with no confirmation gate, while restart and operator stop are gated
redundancy-test parses --pod in internal/broker, skipping the usage marker and the role cross-check
Declining the --out overwrite prompt exits 1, against the house rule that n exits 0
--tail reaches kubectl/docker/podman unvalidated, and its help advertises `all`
validate promises every problem in one pass, but env-file errors stop at the first
Help and README text describe commands and behaviour that do not exist
User-facing errors name retired verb-first commands (remove broker, deploy operator)
The final error line uses a third stderr shape outside internal/output, and the docs show it differently
Real env files under env/ are not gitignored; the old protection only covered the removed docker-podman/env layout
The race flag differs between dev.sh and dev.ps1 and from the contract, so the Windows CI leg never runs -race
gen-cert.sh hides every openssl error, overwrites an existing CA without asking, and splits a scalar san into characters
docs/test.md and CLAUDE.md are out of date on the CI gate, the regen package list and the shared packages
A script(1) terminal capture named 'typescript' is tracked at the repo root
InjectShutdown's unknown-service warning quotes Lines[0], which is a held pragma on exactly the blocks that carry one
broker status --pod is accepted and ignored unless --detail is also given
convert warning names admin.additionalUsers; the key is semp.additionalUsers and admin: is refused
Errors over map-typed fields pick the reported entry in random map order
An empty broker.domainCerts.dirs path is accepted at load and fails only at the op
verifyReplicationSwitch drops the wrong-role verdict when a status page cannot be read
Phase-1 rejection text says it shuts down each listed VPN and that all of them are now disabled
Comments and catalogue rows describe retired flags, commands, tests and fields
Coverage-only tests in coverage_test.go assert constructor defaults and trivial edges
Tests and code cross-reference unresolvable review IDs (M1, M4, M5, M11, M12, H2, H4, H5)
Non-ASCII bytes in two tracked text files
README version sample shows the pre-patch toolchain, and the version command's Long exceeds four lines
Stale ignore entries, and a future docs/review/ is covered by neither .graphifyignore nor the notice test
RewriteAdminUsername discards every operand on the admin opener, so verification demands what was dropped
Destructive-prompt context clause can name the wrong cluster when kubernetes.command carries --context
broker restart/start wait with `rollout status statefulset`, which kubectl refuses for OnDelete StatefulSets
Bare 'busy' keyword in the tail scan can fail a clean chunk deterministically
Credential-bearing artifact lines are printed to stdout by the failure detail and the verification report
Repeated --vpn duplicates every block of that VPN in the artifact
Unrecognised show replication parses as an unconfigured mate and triggers a site-wide replication stop
First podman deploy pulls the broker image inside systemd's default start timeout
Rootless podman on a cgroup v1 host: memory/cpuset caps are not checked for, and the printed remedy cannot fix it
The release target set is defined twice and nothing ties the two together; developer.md calls the local dist list the release targets
